units.source_text: 还有那个太宰大弍的女儿五节小姐，偷偷地恋慕源氏公子，曾经寄信到明石浦来。

en.t: There was also Lady Gosechi, the daughter of the Dazai no Daini, who had secretly fallen in love with Lord Genji and had once sent a letter to Akashi Bay.

units.source_text: 现在公子离浦返京，她的恋情也灰心了，便派一个使者送一封信到二条院。

en.t: Now that the young lord had left the bay and returned to the capital, her hopes in love had faded, so she sent a messenger with a letter to the Nijoin residence.

units.source_text: 吩咐他只须使个眼色，不必言明是谁的信。

en.t: She instructed him that he need only give a hint with his eyes and did not have to say plainly whose letter it was.
In the letter was a poem that said:
